scientific_integrity: The theorem is accompanied by a general inductive discrete-Morse proof and a finite independent checker; no expert or independent scientific audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Describes only layer-swap fixed spaces of ordinary and perfect-matching complexes of graph prisms, not their full equivariant homotopy types.
The graph-perfect-matching count may require exponential computation.
A potentially unindexed earlier broad whiskered-matching classification cannot be excluded.
title: Layer-exchange fixed points of matching complexes of arbitrary graph prisms
